entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: lowerCall routes only its known date-function names to lowerDateFn. Within that admitted set, dateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp excludes timestamp and checks the argument shape; it does not independently whitelist date names. lowerDateFn reaches lowerDateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp only after this recognizer succeeds, leaving the eight date-component names covered by dateFnExpr during validation with nil operands before role-based expression construction.
